important_instructions: The recruitment includes 120 Medical Officer posts under Short Service Commission. There are 90 vacancies for male candidates and 30 for female candidates. Applicants must be Indian citizens. The minimum educational qualification is MBBS. MBBS candidates must have been born on or after 2 January 1997. Postgraduate degree holders must have been born on or after 2 January 1992. All applicants must meet the required physical and mental fitness conditions. Online registration opens on 9 November 2026. The last date for online registration is 18 November 2026. Interviews are tentatively scheduled for December 2026 in Delhi. Detailed eligibility and application instructions are scheduled for publication in Employment News on 7 November 2026. Candidates should regularly check the official AFMS website for updates.

content_sections.text: The age limit depends on whether the candidate holds an MBBS qualification or a postgraduate degree. Age will be calculated as on 31 December 2026 . content_sections.text: The short notification confirms that interviews will be conducted in Delhi, tentatively during December 2026 . Applicants must also meet the prescribed physical and mental fitness requirements. The detailed selection procedure, shortlisting criteria, medical examination standards and final merit rules have not yet been specified in the supplied notice. Candidates should not assume that any particular written examination, NEET PG score requirement or shortlisting formula applies to this recruitment until the detailed notification confirms it.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Armed Forces Medical Services recruitment website at join.afms.gov.in . Open the Medical Officer (Short Service Commission) Recruitment 2026 notification. Read the detailed eligibility requirements and application instructions. Access the online registration facility scheduled to open on 9 November 2026. Complete the registration and candidate login process according to the instructions displayed on the portal. Enter the required personal, educational and professional qualification details. Provide the supporting information and documents requested in the application form. Review the completed form and follow the applicable submission and payment instructions. Submit the online application by 18 November 2026 . Retain the application confirmation for future reference, if provided by the portal. Note: The exact registration fields, document upload requirements and payment steps must be followed as displayed on the official portal and in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Armed Forces Medical Services has announced 120 Medical Officer vacancies, including 90 posts for male candidates and 30 for female candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will AFMS Medical Officer online registration start?
faq.answer: Online registration is scheduled to begin on 9 November 2026 through join.afms.gov.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is MBBS. Candidates must also satisfy the additional eligibility requirements specified in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AFMS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MBBS candidates must be below 30 years, while PG degree holders must be below 35 years as on 31 December 2026. The corresponding eligible birth dates are on or after 2 January 1997 and 2 January 1992, respectively.

faq.question: Q6. When will the AFMS Medical Officer Interview 2026 be conducted?
faq.answer: Interviews are tentatively scheduled in Delhi during December 2026. The exact dates have not been announced in the short notice.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official AFMS website at www.joinafms.gov.in and completing the registration and application submission process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AFMS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contract-based positions consists of an interview, which is tentatively scheduled to be conducted at Delhi in December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer (Short Service Commission) posts will be placed across India with the interview process taking place in Delhi.
